terminal_outcome.text: The host interface displays the returned ended state.
terminal_outcome.rationale: Observed BroadcasterLivePreview updating to show Stream ended label and closing confirmation dialog.
terminal_outcome.evidence_requirement_rationale: Host interface outcome requires observed UI display.

steps.text: The host opens the end-stream action.
steps.criticality_reason: Opening the action is required to trigger the confirmation flow and access the end capability.
steps.rationale: Observed host clicking the visible End button on BroadcasterLivePreview in live state.
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: Host UI interaction is required to open the end-stream action.

source_findings.finding: BroadcasterLivePreview renders End button when canStop is true and binds click to open confirmation dialog.
source_findings.limits: Source analysis does not verify live button click.

steps.text: The client presents the confirmation shown by the design.
steps.criticality_reason: Presenting the confirmation dialog prevents accidental broadcast termination.
steps.rationale: Observed client rendering confirmation section 6007:87451 with prompt text and Cancel / End buttons.
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI rendering of the confirmation dialog must be directly observed.

source_findings.finding: isStopConfirmationOpen state conditionally renders the confirmation dialog section.
source_findings.limits: State condition does not guarantee rendered DOM without runtime observation.

steps.text: The host confirms the action.
steps.criticality_reason: Confirming the action authorizes submission of the stop request to the backend.
steps.rationale: Observed host clicking the confirmation End button, which triggers the stop function.
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: Host confirmation click must be observed in the UI.

source_findings.finding: Confirmation dialog End button onClick calls stop().
source_findings.limits: Static onClick does not verify user interaction.

steps.text: The client submits the stop request.
steps.criticality_reason: Submitting the command to the backend is necessary to mutate stream state.
steps.rationale: Observed HTTP POST request to /api/v1/sessions/:id/live-stream/commands with action STOP and Idempotency-Key.
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: Network capture verifies the actual request transmission and payload.

source_findings.finding: stopLiveStream sends POST request with action STOP and expectedVersion.
source_findings.limits: API helper declaration does not prove network submission.

steps.text: The system returns the ended stream representation.
steps.criticality_reason: Backend must execute the stop mutation, persist ended status, and return HTTP 200 with the ended stream.
steps.rationale: Observed HTTP 200 response with status ENDED and endedAt, and verified live_streams database record updated with version increment.
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: Network response and database inspection together verify ended representation and persistence.

source_findings.finding: SessionsService.commandLiveStream executes UPDATE live_streams SET status = ENDED, version = version + 1, ended_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3).
source_findings.limits: SQL query in service does not verify successful transaction execution.

steps.text: The client displays the post-stream state.
steps.criticality_reason: The client interface must reflect the ended stream outcome to conclude the broadcast.
steps.rationale: Observed streamLabel displaying "Stream ended" and End button removed from active controls.
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI observation verifies that post-stream state is displayed to the user.

source_findings.finding: streamLabel returns "Stream ended" when state.stream.status is ENDED.
source_findings.limits: Helper function return value does not prove UI DOM rendering.

terminal_outcome.text: The client closes the dialog and restores the live session interface.
terminal_outcome.rationale: Observed confirmation dialog closed and live session view restored with no network submission.
terminal_outcome.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI observation of restored live session interface.

steps.text: The host cancels the confirmation.
steps.criticality_reason: Host action rejecting broadcast stop.
steps.rationale: Observed host clicking Cancel button in confirmation section.
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI observation of cancel interaction.

steps.text: The client closes the dialog and restores the live session interface.
steps.criticality_reason: Dialog closure and live session preservation is the branch terminal requirement.
steps.rationale: Observed confirmation section removed from DOM; live session interface remains active.
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI observation of dialog closure and view restoration.

terminal_outcome.rationale: Observed client displaying failure alert banner while maintaining the session view.

evidence.locator: Error alert displayed and view preserved

steps.text: The system cannot complete the stop request.
steps.criticality_reason: System failure response triggers the exception branch.
steps.rationale: Observed backend returning HTTP 409 Conflict with message "The stream version is no longer current".
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: Network capture of error status and message.

steps.text: The client displays the returned failure state and preserves the current session view.
steps.criticality_reason: Displaying the failure state while preserving the current view is the terminal exception requirement.
steps.rationale: Observed error alert banner rendered with backend message while live session preview remains visible.

evidence.locator: Error alert displayed and view preserved

steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI observation of error message display and preserved session view.
